justification: Both surfaces show low-relief creatures on a flat vertical panel, including a profile head with a strong hooked beak, and both use a horizontal band to separate zones with a row of repeated forms above. Beyond that the content diverges sharply: B depicts a single large winged anthropomorphic figure with a bird head holding a bucket and cone beside stylised plants and a block of dense script, rendered with detailed feather and garment patterning, while A shows several small, flat, schematic animals (quadrupeds, birds, snake-like forms) scattered without a dominant figure, plants, gesture-object or text.}
